text:
Taylor: hey team quick run-down

I just finished benefits enrollment but a couple things unclear:
- how do i add my spouse as a dependent? is there a deadline to backdate coverage? 
- can i still change FSA election this quarter? missed the form during onboarding. 
- commuter card setup 1/ is that separate from benefits portal? 
- also want to update my W-4 (marital status changed) 

Jamie (People Ops): welcome Taylor! short answers:
- dependents: upload proof (marriage cert + spouse SSN) in Workday > Benefits > Life Events. If you want coverage effective from your hire date we need docs within 30 days to backdate; otherwise effective next pay-period.
- FSA: elections are locked after initial enrollment window except for qualifying life events. If you had a qualifying event (marriage) you can change now via the same Life Events flow.
- commuter: separate — go to the Commuter Benefits portal (link in the benefits email). You get a virtual commuter card once HR approves the election.
- W-4: update in Payroll portal (PayCenter) or submit a signed PDF to payroll@redwood.ai. Payroll will confirm new withholdings on the next cycle.

Taylor: perfect. how long to process dependent docs? dont want a gap for upcoming appt.

Maya (Benefits): usually 3-5 business days after docs are uploaded. If you need immediate proof for a provider, DM me the spouse name and DOB and i'll send a pending-letter you can use.

Taylor: thanks. also i reimbursed a moving expense on my card last week1 how do i get that reimbursed? 

Jamie (People Ops): submit in Concur under Expense Type = "Relocation" and include the signed relocation packet (you should have received it from Talent). Tag policy REL-2025. Finance typically issues reimbursements on the next two-cycle run.

Taylor: last Q 1/1 we have a floating holiday this quarter? my manager mentioned a company holiday but not sure date.

HRBot: Reminder: Observed company holidays for 2026 are posted in the HR calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/hr-holidays. Floating holiday must be scheduled in Workday > Time Off > Request t least 5 business days in advance.

Taylor: sweet, thanks everyone. i'll upload docs and update W-4 now. :thumbsup:

Maya (Benefits): Ping me here if you hit any upload errors — sometimes browser autofill breaks the PDF multipart. If that happens, drop the file in the secure link and tell me the filename.

Taylor: will do. appreciate the quick help!
